name: immersion-shims
//: packageManager and .github/workflows/shims.yml must name the same Bun: the vendored bundle is byte-compared against a rebuild, and different Bun versions mangle identifiers differently.

scripts.//test: the shims have no unit tests; what they have is a drift check. immersion/src is generated from immersion/ts and committed so `cargo build` needs no JavaScript toolchain, so the thing worth failing on is the two disagreeing.
scripts.test: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- immersion/src immersion/ts/generated
scripts.build:vendor: bun run build:diffs && bun run build:vega && bun run build:icons
